pins.definition: To move downwards from a higher to a lower place.
To drop from a higher position to a lower one, often to the ground.
To move downwards from a higher level or lose balance and drop to the ground.

situation: A clumsy delivery man on a pavement is mid-air, having tripped over a loose paving stone while carrying a towering stack of cardboard boxes.
subject: the moment of dropping and losing balance toward the ground
brief: A middle-aged man in a uniform is suspended horizontally mid-air above a city sidewalk, having just tripped over a cracked curb. A towering pyramid of identical brown cardboard boxes he was carrying has exploded outward into the air around him, caught tumbling downward at various angles toward the concrete.
